article_brainrot.summary: Short videos and infinite feeds are engineered to hold your attention, and the result is a tired, scattered feeling after hours of scrolling. After reading this you can tell the difference between a weak attention span and a strong habit, spot the signs that the feed has taken over your day, and run a one-week reset that gives you your focus back.
article_brainrot.title: Brain Rot: Is the Internet Destroying Our Attention Span?

article_kids_animals_savanna.summary: The savanna is a great open grassland full of grass eaters and hungry hunters. After reading this you can name the animals that live there, use the words scientists use for them, and explain what happens on a savanna in the space of one day.
article_kids_animals_savanna.title: Amazing Animals of the African Savanna
